description.value: You've learned to lift a ration card or a spare part without the mark ever hearing the click. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Steal an item that weighs light Bulk or less.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +1 Steal bonus is conditioned on the target item weighing 'light Bulk or less' -- no confirmed item-Bulk-category predicate exists for a Steal check to read against an arbitrary target item.
